name: RM (Kim Nam-joon)
role: Leader & Main Rapper. First Big Hit recruit; group's intellectual and artistic anchor. Fluent in English; delivered BTS's UN speeches. Released 2nd solo album 'Right Place, Wrong Person' (May 2024) while serving. Discharged June 10, 2025. Performed the ARIRANG comeback concert seated after an ankle injury but fully recovered for the ongoing ARIRANG World Tour. Delivered a farewell address in Spanish at Mexico City Night 3. Led the Busan 13th anniversary homecoming (Jun 12-13) and the ARIRANG tour's European finale in Paris (Jul 17-18). Performed alongside the group at the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show (Jul 19). Co-signed BTS's July 29 Instagram statement declining to submit ARIRANG for 2027 Grammy consideration following the Recording Academy's new Asian Pop category. Aug 13: drew ARMY backlash after attending Chris Brown and Usher's Toronto concert and posing with Brown, ahead of BTS's own Rogers Stadium shows. Performed both Toronto Rogers Stadium shows (Aug 22-23) — night one delayed by a thunderstorm warning, night two closing with 'Outro: Tear,' its first live performance since 2019.
quote: No matter who you are, where you're from, your skin color, your gender identity: speak yourself.

name: Jin (Kim Seok-jin)
role: Vocalist & Visual. Eldest BTS member; first to enlist and first to discharge (June 2024). Released debut solo album 'Happy' (Nov 2024, Billboard 200 No. 4). Solo EP 'Echo' (May 2025); 'Don't Say You Love Me' surpassed 800M Spotify streams in 2026. Known for 'Worldwide Handsome' humor and emotional ballad vocals. May 25, 2026: accepted Artist of the Year award on behalf of BTS at the 52nd AMAs. June 1: BTS FESTA 2026 begins — Jin's 13th FESTA as a BTS member. Performed at the Busan 13th anniversary homecoming, the ARIRANG tour's European leg (Brussels, London, Munich, Paris), and the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show alongside the full group.
quote: I believe I am worldwide handsome — because I believe in myself. That is the most important thing.

name: Suga (Min Yoon-gi)
role: Lead Rapper & Producer. Also performs solo as Agust D. Served alternative social service (Sep 2023–Jun 21, 2025) — last BTS member to complete military duty. Prolific songwriter and producer, frank about mental health and depression. ARIRANG 2026: co-produced vinyl-exclusive hidden track 'Come Over' with RM and J-Hope. Performing in all ARIRANG World Tour shows, including the Busan 13th anniversary homecoming, the European leg finale in Paris, and the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show. BTS FESTA 2026: present in family photo released June 4 — first full seven-member anniversary photo since all members completed service.
quote: I don't want to be a person who just makes great music. I want to be a person who changes the world.

name: J-Hope (Jung Ho-seok)
role: Lead Rapper & Main Dancer. Group mood-maker; first Korean artist to headline Lollapalooza (2022). Discharged Oct 2024 after serving as assistant drill instructor. Launched 'Hope on the Stage' solo world tour (Feb 2025). 2026: Louis Vuitton × Pharrell collab (BUTTERSOFT pink suede sneaker). Las Vegas (May 23): visited Urban Matcha in Las Vegas Chinatown — viral video drove a documented ARMY surge at Korean small businesses across the corridor. Performed with the full group at the Busan homecoming, the ARIRANG tour's European leg, and the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show (Jul 19). Aug 13: drew ARMY backlash after attending Chris Brown and Usher's Toronto concert and posing with Brown, ahead of BTS's own Rogers Stadium shows (Aug 22-23). Features on LE SSERAFIM's 'Spaghetti,' nominated for Best K-Pop at the 2026 MTV VMAs.
quote: I want to be a good influence on people. If my music can make someone happy or give them strength, that's enough for me.

name: Jimin (Park Ji-min)
role: Vocalist & Main Dancer (Jimin). First Korean solo artist to top the Billboard Hot 100 ('Like Crazy', 2023). Second solo album 'MUSE' (2024) surpassed 1B Spotify streams. Discharged June 11, 2025. May 25, 2026: performed at 52nd AMAs and accepted Song of the Summer award for 'SWIM'. Performed with the group at the Busan homecoming, the ARIRANG tour's European leg (record-setting Paris finale), and the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show.
quote: I want to show ARMY the best of me, no matter what. I never want to disappoint the people who believe in me.

name: V (Kim Tae-hyung)
role: Vocalist & Visual. Known for his deep baritone voice and eccentric personality. Debut solo album 'Layover' (2023) showcased a jazz/R&B sound. Served in the 2nd Division Special Duty Team; discharged June 10, 2025. 2026: performing across all ARIRANG World Tour dates; closed Mexico City Night 3 (May 10) with a viral Spanish farewell that trended globally. BTS FESTA 2026: featured in the June 4 family photo — his first FESTA family photo since discharge. Performed at the Busan homecoming, the European leg's record Paris finale, and the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show. Aug 12: disclosed on a Weverse Live that he's being treated for hearing loss in his right ear, a condition he says worsened during military service; continued performing through the Arlington AT&T Stadium shows (Aug 15-16).
quote: I have remade my mind and body, and now I want to run to ARMY as quickly as I can.

name: Jungkook (Jeon Jung-kook)
role: Main Vocalist, Main Dancer & Maknae (youngest). Solo album 'GOLDEN' (2023) is the best-selling K-pop solo album in US history. Discharged June 11, 2025. Multi-talented: sings, raps, dances, and produces. May 2026: 'CKJK' × Calvin Klein collaboration sold out in 30 min in US and 1 min in China on May 20 launch. June 7, 2026 (FESTA Day 7): 'Never Let Go' (June 2024 anniversary track) re-released on YouTube and Spotify as part of FESTA 2026 programming ahead of the 13th anniversary. Performed at the Busan homecoming (his hometown), the ARIRANG tour's European leg, and the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show. Aug 12: revealed on a Weverse Live that he's nursing a shin injury (on the verge of a stress fracture) from the tour's North American leg, and plans treatment once the tour returns to Korea.
quote: I think this spring will be more important than ever. We're coming back to the stage, and I want to give ARMY everything.
